name: Shanghai Skychem Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Skychem Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sales of functional wet electronic chemicals used in electronic circuits, displays, new energy, and advanced packaging in China. It offers carrier plate specialty chemicals, touchscreen copper plating and touchscreen blackening, kong metal one-stop service, electroplating additives, copper surface treatment, and advanced packaging solutions. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Skychem Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai Skychem Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2025. Shanghai Skychem Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.
